subject: Event Playbook: One-pager + Live Demo Runbook (Finlytics sponsorship)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Event Playbook: One-pager + Live Demo Runbook (Finlytics sponsorship)

Hi Jared / Emily —

Thanks again for sponsoring our Bay Area fintech meetup on Oct 21. Per our prep call, I’m attaching a draft event playbook and an initial live-demo runbook so we can align on deliverables and handoffs early. High-level we want to deliver:

- A one-page customer-facing sponsorship one-pager (logo + 3 bullets on why Redwood)
- A short slide insert (~1 slide) explaining the joint proof point / metrics
- A 10–12 minute live demo sequence (10-min demo + 2-min Q&A)
- Booth runbook (staffing + rapid fallback scripts)

Attachments (stubs): event-playbook-v0.9.docx (one-pager + timeline), demo-runbook-v0.2.pptx (live sequence & slide placeholders).

Can you review and send any branding guidelines or required language? Also call out any metrics you want highlighted (e.g., latency at <50ms, cost per 1k tokens). If possible, can you provide that by EOD Oct 3 — so we have time to update slides and the one-pager for your legal team?

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa to own the one-pager copy + design updates
- Laura to draft the joint metrics slide
- Quick run-through rehearsal the week of Oct 12 (we’ll schedule once slides are locked)

Talk soon — appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Karthik Iyer
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: Jared Cole <jared.cole@finlytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@finlytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Event Playbook: One-pager + Live Demo Runbook (Finlytics sponsorship)

Karthik —

Thanks, received. Quick notes:

- We do have brand guidelines; attaching a PDF (finlytics-brand-guidelines.pdf). Please use our logomark and the navy palette.
- For the metrics slide: can you call out “95th percentile inference latency” and “cost per 1k tokens”? Our marketing ops prefers that phrasing.
- For the demo, we want to show a short example of secure data routing (how Redwood handles customer VPC keys) plus a quick mention of dedicated capacity for predictable throughput. The demo should not surface any PII.

We’ll review the one-pager internally and get back with any legal copy redlines by Oct 4. Also: could we include one customer quote from our finance team? I can try to source a 1–2 sentence blurb.

— Jared
Customer Success & Partnerships
Finlytics

Attachment: finlytics-brand-guidelines.pdf

Thanks Jared — good recs. Quick internal plan:

- Marissa: will update the one-pager copy to include Finlytics co-brand line and 3 suggested callouts (value props + CTA).
- Laura: will draft the metrics slide with the exact phrasing Jared requested. Please include an illustrative chart (latency distribution) but keep it stylized — no customer data.
- Evelyn: can you own the demo checklist and ensure no PII flows in the recording/mock data? We’ll use synthetic credentials and a sandbox dataset.

Timeline:
- Marissa to send revised one-pager by Oct 4 EOD
- Laura to drop first draft of metrics slide by Oct 4 midday
- Evelyn to provide sanitized demo script + test data by Oct 5

I’ll also start a shared Drive folder and populate with assets; Karthik can loop in design for the final polish.

— Marissa
Sr. Product Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
